headline: Proposal to let Building Commissioner approve disability home changes without zoning board review stays in committee
summary: The proposal would let the Building Commissioner approve qualifying home changes, such as a first-floor bedroom addition, without sending them to the zoning board. The city solicitor suggested adding a few words to section 9.1.2 of the zoning code instead of creating a new process. The draft would set a 30-day timeline and would require a joint public hearing with the Planning Board. Public speakers, including the zoning board chair, supported the change.
decisions: Kept the administrative review ordinance for disability accommodations in committee, with four hands counted in favor.
discussion: Building Commissioner review: Members asked how requests would be reviewed. The city solicitor said the change would let the Building Commissioner grant accommodations administratively, while ramps would be exempt and setback requests would be judged case by case.

Historic districts: Members asked whether historic commission rules still apply. The city solicitor said that authority remains, that screens have been used before, and that a waiver request could be heard in executive session.
Fees: Members asked whether permit fees could be waived for these requests. City staff said they know of no permit fee that has been waived for any reason.
Public comment: Residents and the zoning board chair supported the change. They cited long waits, the cost of lawyers, and the need to disclose private medical information in public meetings.
Timing: Members discussed the zoning clock and the holidays. They agreed a joint public hearing with the Planning Board would be needed before the change could take effect.

decision_evidence.quote: So I'd like to make a motion that this remain in committee. All right, Councillor Smith would like this administration review to remain in committee, seconded by Councillor Hapworth. All those in favor? I'd like the record show I see three hands plus my own so the matter will remain in committee.

decision_titles: Administrative review for disability accommodations in zoning
